name: thrice-providers
description: Built-in AgentCLI hubs. Extra models use the same instance shape as T3 Code.

chatParticipants.name: thrice
chatParticipants.description: Chat through the built-in AgentCLI hubs.

thrice.providers.instances.description: Extra provider instances, in the same shape T3 Code stores. The AgentCLI hubs are already included. An entry with the same id replaces that hub.

driver.description: Which installed CLI runs this instance.

displayName.description: Name shown as the provider. Models are listed inside it.

command.description: Executable name or path. Defaults to the driver CLI.

launchArgs.description: Arguments placed before the driver's own prompt arguments.

environment.description: Environment entries for this instance. Values stay in your user settings.

thrice.chat.mode.description: How the next chat turn runs. Interactive and Debug change the project, Plan and Spec only write, Ask and Triage only answer, and Background finishes without waiting.

thrice.agents.maxDepth.description: How deep agents may start other agents through the thrice MCP server. 1 lets a chat agent start agents that cannot start more. 0 turns runAgent off.

thrice.agents.maxRunning.description: Most agents started by other agents that may run at once in this window.

thrice.chat.ghostText.enabled.description: Suggest the rest of a chat message from previous messages while you type.
